test_send_signal_basic_text: test the _send_signal function to send a basic text-only Signal message without media attachments
test_send_signal_with_attachments: test the _send_signal function to send a Signal message with media file attachments
test_send_signal_missing_media: test the _send_signal function handles missing media files gracefully with warnings instead of failures
test_send_to_platform_restrictions: test the _send_to_platform function enforces media restrictions for non-Signal platforms like Slack
test_send_signal_group_chats: test the _send_signal function sends Signal group chat messages with attachments using groupId parameter
